events.assessment: The customer C08106 has explicitly disputed transaction 3583227 ($128.33), which was conducted using a 'New' generic device profile and a hotmail.com email address. Although the transaction amount is within the historical baseline maximum of $138.89, the change in device and email signature supports the customer's claim of unauthorized activity.
